notes: The booklet drawings are small and ambiguous, so the exact position of some pieces is my best reading. All 53 pieces and each part type's count match the parts list.

Reading of the build: a 2x4 plate and a 2x2 plate sit on the lime base between two black 1x2 plates. A 1x4 brick and a 1x2 brick go on the back, black curved legs on the sides, and two black curved 2x1 pieces on the front 2x2 plate. Two red side-stud bricks form the chest, with black 1x1 plates and inverted brackets at each side.

The 6091 arms sit on the bracket and the 1x1 black plate. A black 2x2x2/3 plate and black 2x2 plate carry four 1x1 side-stud bricks for the head. A white 2x2 plate, two jumper plates and the dark pink 1x2 plate cap the head.
Step 15 shows a black piece pushed onto the head from the side; I treated it as the black round nose tile on a head side stud.
Ears are white clip plates pushed sideways onto side studs, each with a black round tile on its stud. Eyes are the printed tiles on front side studs.

The foot is a white 2x2 plate on the two side studs of the 99206, with a jumper plate, a curved 15068 and a black round tile. Three more white 1x2 plate + curved 15068 sub-assemblies (the '3x' box) are pushed onto head side studs.
The heart goes onto the front red brick's side studs in step 18.

Two black 6091 curved bricks (b52, b53) are placed on the pink head plate and on the heart studs. This is an assumption made to account for the parts list, because the booklet is unclear about the last two 6091.
The 15068 element is listed as 6552147 in the inventory but appears as 6047220 in the booklet; I used the inventory type.
All connections are modelled as rests_on or other_joins. Positions are left null.
